# AIS-FIT-02

**Is the model's role in each element stated, and limited to that role?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [AI solution lens](ai-solution.md) 0.4.0 |
| Area | FIT: Fitness for AI |
| Default severity | minor |
| Decided by | A tool checks presence; a reviewer judges |
| Reads | `elements.ai.role`, `elements.responsibilities` |

## Rule

Every element with an ai facet has role and at least one responsibility.

- ISO/IEC 25059:2023, Quality model for AI systems (`iso25059`)
